title.en: The index of the maximum of a sequence

description.zh:
序列由整數組成，以數字 0 結尾。確定序列中最大元素的索引。如果最高元素不唯一，則列印第一個元素的索引。

Java 注意： 輸入以 0 結束時不要把結尾的 0 納入統計；可能出現小數結果時使用 double。
description.en:
A sequence consists of integer numbers and ends with the number 0. Determine the index of the largest element of the sequence. If the highest element is not unique, print the index of the first of them.

Java note: Do not include a terminating zero in the sequence. Use double when the result may be fractional.

hint.zh: 輸入以 0 結束時不要把結尾的 0 納入統計；可能出現小數結果時使用 double。
hint.en: Do not include a terminating zero in the sequence. Use double when the result may be fractional.
